_comment: contacts-mirror settings. 'reader' is the command that prints the cards as JSON (schema in README.md); it is a placeholder until Nelson picks the reader road. 'keys' is the list of vCard key families the mirror carries: the people ship will send its list, and this is the only place to change it. 'create' is who gets a new note: only 'none' exists until the people ship rules. The job never writes a key outside 'keys', except 'modified', 'contact-status' and 'contact-missing-since'. The key list is the people ship's (2026-09-30): FN, the N keys, TEL, ORG, ROLE, BDAY, ANNIVERSARY. EMAIL, ADR and URL keys are not on it, so the job leaves them as they are. The job never writes source, UID or VERSION (the captain's word, 2026-09-30: leaving them untouched keeps them).
